_: Guard 4's baseline; see contrast.browser.test.jsx. `allow` lists ink/ground pairs known to sit below `floor`, each with the ratio measured when it was recorded. A listed pair may never get worse, and must be REMOVED once it clears the floor -- the guard fails either way. Nothing may be ADDED without a note here saying why the pair cannot be fixed. Keys are `theme|ink|ground` for the contract matrix and `theme|@selector` for a real call site.
_allow: Recorded on the sheet as it stood when the guard was written, so the guard lands green and every later change is measured against it. Three separate defects, all pre-existing: (1) --text-secondary has no headroom on paper -- it clears the floor on --bg-main and --bg-card and fails on the two darker card grounds; (2) the Today strip and the kanji chip are sumi in BOTH themes but use the ambient ink, which flips dark in light theme; (3) the dim/placeholder registers mix their ink toward `transparent`, which composites toward the ground and fails in BOTH themes.
